description: Two independent closed hi-hat voices, each playing back one of 15 recorded samples.

params.text: Chooses which of that voice's 15 samples plays, stepping between whole numbers from 0 to 14; 0 and 1 both give the first sample and the last of the 15 can never be reached.
Sets the playback rate of that voice's sample, from 0.2x to 1.8x of the recorded speed, which shifts its pitch and its length together.

inputs.text: Adds to the SELECT knob at 1.4 samples per volt, with the total clamped between 0 and 14.
Restarts that voice's sample from its first frame whenever the voltage rises through 0.5V.
Adds to the TUNE knob at 1x of playback rate per volt, with the total clamped between 0.2x and 1.8x.

outputs.text: The audio of that voice's sample, played once through at the rate TUNE sets and then silent.

notes: a voice is only computed while there is a cable in its OUT jack, so with nothing patched there the gate input produces nothing.
the panel carries two voices with their own select, tune, gate and output; they run at the same time and share no controls.
